description: This file declares functions for managing a vector of data model instances, including initialization, addition, removal, querying, and dumping of instance data.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes a vector of data model instances.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys a vector of data model instances, freeing resources.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a new instance to the vector.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_Remove
methods.description: Removes an instance from the vector.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_IsExist
methods.description: Checks if a specific instance exists in the vector.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_DoesFirstLevelInstanceExist
methods.description: Checks if a first-level instance exists under a given node.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_GetNextInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the next instance after a given node and current instance.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_GetNumInstances
methods.description: Returns the number of instances for a given node and match criteria.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_GetInstances
methods.description: Retrieves all instances for a given node.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_GetAllInstancePaths_Unqualified
methods.description: Retrieves all instance paths without qualification.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_RefreshBaselineInstances
methods.description: Refreshes baseline instances for a parent node.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_DumpTable
methods.description: Dumps the instance table to a specified path.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_Dump
methods.description: Dumps the vector of instances for debugging or logging.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_RefreshInstance
methods.description: Refreshes or updates an instance based on a given path.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_RefreshTopLevelObjectInstances
methods.description: Refreshes top-level object instances under a specified node.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_NextLockPeriod
methods.description: Advances or handles the next lock period for instance management.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_SetRefreshOverride
methods.description: Sets a flag to override refresh behavior.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_SeedInstance
methods.description: Seeds or pre-creates an instance with expiry and group ID assumptions (not included if REMOVE_USP_BROKER is defined).
